- `hero.jpg`: Seb Seb — [A Steering Wheel Behind a Car Window](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-steering-wheel-behind-a-car-window-15751556/).

- `janela.jpg`: Inline Media — [Stylish interior of modern car parked on street](https://www.pexels.com/photo/stylish-interior-of-modern-car-parked-on-street-5229548/).
- `interior.jpg`: Erik Mclean — [Car Interior with Steering Wheel](https://www.pexels.com/photo/car-interior-with-steering-wheel-12765620/).
